Overnight run on 11/19 at 04:01 UTC, the first since 11/16 14:51 (~61h gap; the 11/16 late wake didn't run). The 11/16-11/18 closes were rebuilt from broker candles, the SPY 20:55 bar and dated recaps.

Findings:
- SPY regular closes ~739.4 / ~731.8 / 730.41, five straight losses. 11/17 and 11/18 both closed under the ~732.6/732.8 200-day, so the regime is now DEFENSIVE. Leaving Defensive takes two consecutive regular closes above the 200-day.
- VIX 22.9 / 25.5 / 24.6. The 10y fell to 5.07%.
- NVDA beat and raised, then fell 2.9%.
- On the 11/17 flush, the defensive sectors fell more than the S&P.
- A CMS Medicare Advantage proposal took XLV -2.2% to 181.18, under the 184.5 trail.

Orders:
- Close both XLV tranches. Marked +4.64% and +1.74% vs SPY ~-5% over the same windows; provisional grade A.
- Hold XLP (91.19; exit on a close under 88.6) and both SGOV lots.
- No opens: the regime is Defensive, XLU is under its 44 trigger, XLE is cancelled (WTI $83), and SPY is far from its rebuild lines.

Weekly review written (reviews/2026-11-19.md). Playbook moves to v1.9:
- The 10y level gate is retired ('right result, wrong mechanism').
- New: a relative-strength gate for bond proxies when the 10y is above 5%.
- New: a stress gate on all new risk opens (no template day, no 2 sessions after one, VIX close at or below 25).
- New: a re-entry rule after a trail exit.
- The Defensive SGOV cap of 60% applies immediately.
- New wake-gap protocol.

At the 14:45 UTC run:
- Confirm the XLV fills.
- Open a $2,000 SGOV lot (stop 99.0, TP 103).
- Check SPY vs the ~733.0 200-day, VIX for the stress gate, XLU vs 44, and XLP vs 88.6.

Equity $9,867.93: -0.81% since inception vs SPY -4.97%; drawdown 2.45% from the HWM.

The same trail exit covers the XLV add tranche (entry 178.09): the 11/18 regular close of 181.18 is under 184.5. Expected fill at the 11/19 open. Marked +1.74% vs SPY ~-5.4% over the same window.
